high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post celebrating the achievement of @DGukesh, who became the youngest-ever World Chess Champion. The post includes a message of congratulations and pride, along with a cash prize announcement. Text Content: The post begins by honoring @DGukesh for his monumental achievement as the youngest-ever World Chess Champion. It announces a cash prize of ₹5 crore to honor his victory. The post expresses pride and joy over his historic win and wishes him well for future achievements. It acknowledges the support of Hon'ble @Udhay
